method:
Actual Coastward post/lamp main-view qualification in software WebGL.

An isolated native profile imports the command-earned Chapter I checkpoint,
uses visible Roads/map/bridge-view controls and ordinary RAF. Edge/bank legs
call the same accepted Simulation.moveTo that the UI uses; no coordinates,
ticks, HP, gear or rewards are assigned. A synchronous appearance-only probe
changes only the 34 opted-in decorative cutaway flags, restores before play
continues, and captures the actual traveler. A separate blue-box fixture uses
unchanged submitted post/lamp meshes and the actual camera; it is a controlled
occlusion test, not a traveler or gameplay photograph. Every reflection is
freshly rendered with water enabled, including geometry-absent controls.
This is software integration/pixel evidence, not hardware performance or feel.

definition.name: Earth · Coastward Road
definition.kicker: Broader Earth foundation · provisional local geography
definition.description: A long channel bridge opens onto woodland lanes, working fields and a small roadside settlement. Coastward Road is a provisional extension; Hearthwater and its people retain their existing places and history. Two western junctions continue into Elderweald-facing woodland, an inhabited clearing, a wetland footbridge and an ancient root-channel passage.
definition.sourceNotes: Original opening inspired by Earth E02 Crownfields, E05 Reedmere and E08 Rainward. Coastward Road, Merren and Vessa are new provisional names, not recovered manuscript canon. The Elderweald-facing circuit adapts Earth E03 and ET11/ET12; its local people and work remain original provisional implementation.

points.name: Return to Firstlight checkpoint
points.text: The home road is always open.
points.detail: Return directly to your original Firstlight checkpoint, or follow the nearby signed road through Hearthwater. Existing Earth stories keep their own history.

points.name: Vessa · bridge keeper
points.text: A bridge is only impressive if the next person can cross it.
points.detail: Vessa is an original provisional local. The channel crossing and both woodland lanes lead to the fields; the coppice branch is optional.

points.name: The channel crossing
points.text: A continuous timber crossing joins both banks.
points.detail: The bridge is real supported ground with two solid rails. No swimming or boat control is implied.

points.name: Rainward-facing overlook
points.text: Beyond the worked fields, the water opens toward the coast.
points.detail: Rainward belongs to Earth. This is a local coastal outlook, not a completed port or the whole Earth map.

points.name: Merren · field steward
points.text: Check the water, pack the named load, then register it. I would rather have one dependable evening than a heroic story about ruined cabbages.
points.detail: Merren is an original provisional local. The field-water and produce commission is ordinary work; it does not advance the prophecy or replace Fenna’s existing delivery.

points.name: Field-water catch
points.text: Check the catch and record the working field-water gauge.
points.detail: The catch belongs to these fields. This is a bounded work interaction, not a fluid simulation or a repair of Ansel’s existing mill.

points.name: The evening produce load
points.text: Pack the declared roadside produce load.
points.detail: Work applies only to this commission. Decorative vegetables do not become free inventory or an unlimited harvest.

points.name: Roadside delivery register
points.text: Enter the named load and its field-water check in the local register.
points.detail: This register records the local work. It does not invent online trading or replay Bellweather’s existing story reward.

points.name: Hearthwater road · home and Oren’s workshop
points.text: The channel-bank track joins the orchard and ridge roads.
points.detail: Continue on foot through the local scene boundary. The original Firstlight checkpoint remains unchanged; walking accepts no quest or reward.

points.name: Rill · forestkeeper
points.text: The road stays open. Take a look at the load before choosing what to carry.
points.detail: A local keeper at an ordinary working camp. The work is offered; entering the country accepts nothing.

points.name: Sela · herbalist
points.text: The reeds mark wet ground. Keep the walking line firm and leave the living beds alone.
points.detail: A quiet stop beside the wetland edge; no new harvesting or allegiance follows this conversation.

points.name: Camp preparation
points.text: Read the load before choosing material.
points.detail: An open packing space beside the camp.

points.name: Stormfall stock
points.text: Storm-fallen timber lies beside the track.
points.detail: This original set dressing is distinct from an inventory grant.

points.name: Managed growth
points.text: A marked working stand offers a different allocation.
points.detail: An ordinary designated work area; standing scenery is not harvestable.

points.name: Wetland edge
points.text: Read the wet ground before placing a support.
points.detail: The river gap has one supported footbridge; the reeds are scenery.

points.name: Root-channel load
points.text: Look down the open root channel before entering.
points.detail: The route passes between the original masonry flanks. Its overhead roots clear a standing traveller.

points.name: Root-channel support
points.text: A support station stands beyond the passage.
points.detail: The open working space is south of both flank walls.

points.name: Return glade delivery
points.text: The return track opens into a packing glade.
points.detail: A local delivery point; the ordinary road continues back to Coastward.

quest.title: Water, fields and the evening load
quest.completionText: The local field-water check, produce packing and delivery record are complete. Merren can account for this evening’s work; the older Hearthwater delivery keeps its own history.
